tasks.title: Replace hydraulic hose on unit 12
tasks.description: Boom cylinder feed line is weeping at the crimp. Bring a 3/4in hose assembly and two 90-degree fittings. Machine must be locked out before starting.

tasks.title: 500-hour generator service
tasks.description: Scheduled service on the standby generator: oil and filter change, coolant top-up, load-bank test for 30 minutes, and record readings in the site log.

tasks.title: Annual lift inspection — Registan site
tasks.description: Statutory inspection of the scissor lift: check guardrails, emergency lowering, hydraulic leaks and the last certificate date. Photograph the data plate for the report.

tasks.title: Spare parts stock count
tasks.description: Quarterly count of consumables in the Namangan warehouse. Reconcile against the parts list and flag anything below the reorder level.
